reason: PREREG v0 section 3 specified the OUTPUT contract ('Final answer: X') but never froze the prompt itself, the interface (bare vs chat), the anchor, the injection site, or the stopping condition. Section 4 forbids redesigning the prompt after a failed preflight -- a rule that is vacuous if the prompt was never frozen. This amendment closes that gap BEFORE any generation exists. It adds; it edits nothing already frozen.

prompt.field_source: LogiQA2.0 test.txt: text, question, options[0..3], stripped of surrounding whitespace only
prompt.note_empty_passage: If passage is empty after stripping, the passage line AND the blank line after it are both omitted, so the prompt never opens with a blank line. Measured at freeze: all 1572 rows carry a non-empty passage, so this branch is defensive and is asserted, not exercised.

interface.why: The NMD mask was extracted on bare-string prompts, so steering must inject into the same activation distribution. GSM8K, MATH, GSM-Hard and the P3 CoT supplement are all bare; keeping LogiQA bare is what makes the transferred workpoint the same intervention. This is the repo default, stated explicitly because two experiments (betting, CGT) are deliberate chat exceptions.

anchor_and_injection.anchor_note: ONE literal ASCII trailing space; the prompt ends here and nothing may follow it
anchor_and_injection.measured_how: AutoTokenizer on the real checkpoints, add_special_tokens=True, 2026-09-01

double_bos_risk.llama3.1-8B: bos_token_id=128000, no double BOS observed on the bare path

anchor_and_injection.hazard_rstrip: rstrip() on this prompt moves the tail token from 220 to ':' (25) and silently relocates the injection site. The trailing space is an assertion, not a formatting preference.
anchor_and_injection.expected_steering_fires: L * B * 1 per batch (llama L=9, qwen L=6); alpha=0 fires 0

stopping.why_no_stop_string: HF stop_strings halts on the substring appearing ANYWHERE in the output. The prompt literally contains "Final answer: X" in its instruction, and the model routinely restates an instruction while reasoning, so any stop string built from that phrase can truncate before the real answer -- the failure CGT already paid for (invalid_rate 0.02 -> 0.11). Generation ends at natural EOS or at max_new_tokens.

decoding.batch_size_note: held identical across a model's two cells; batched vs bs=1 differ by ~2% on Llama due to padding

generation_metadata.implementation_note: VicundaModel.regenerate() returns list[str] only; llms.py:1024 already holds gen_ids and discards it after decoding. A metadata-return path must be added there, DEFAULT OFF (return_metadata=False) so every existing caller stays byte-identical. Deriving the count by re-tokenizing the decoded text afterwards is NOT acceptable as the primary measurement: decode(skip_special_tokens=True) drops the EOS and re-tokenization is approximate at the boundary -- the same gap that made P3 under-report Llama's cap rate by ~12 pp.

parsing_regex.flags: none (case-sensitive, matching the prompt's literal casing)
